description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingListEvents class, which manages shopping list operations such as adding items from the cart, creating auto-save lists, restoring lists, and handling cookies for guest users within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for manipulating shopping list records, integrating with shopping cart data, and handling user interactions related to shopping lists.

classes.name: ShoppingListEvents
classes.description: This class handles shopping list operations such as adding items from cart, creating auto-save lists, restoring lists, handling guest cookies, and managing shopping list records within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addBulkFromCart
methods.description: Adds multiple items from the shopping cart to a specified shopping list, creating a new list if needed, with options for appending or replacing existing list contents.

methods.name: addBulkFromCart
methods.description: Internal method that adds specified cart items to a shopping list, creating the list if it does not exist, with control over promo allowance and appending behavior.

methods.name: addListToCart
methods.description: Adds items from a specified shopping list to the shopping cart, with options for including child lists, setting the list as default, and appending vs. replacing cart contents.

methods.name: addListToCart
methods.description: Internal method that loads a shopping list and adds its items to the cart, handling related records and attributes.

methods.name: replaceShoppingListItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a shopping list item based on request parameters.

methods.name: getAutoSaveListId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a specialized 'auto-save' shopping list used to persist shopping cart contents between user visits.

methods.name: fillAutoSaveList
methods.description: Populates the auto-save shopping list with the current cart contents, creating or clearing the list as needed.

methods.name: saveCartToAutoSaveList
methods.description: Saves the current shopping cart's contents into the auto-save list.

methods.name: restoreAutoSaveList
methods.description: Restores the auto-save shopping list back into the user's shopping cart, considering modifications and last load time.

methods.name: clearListInfo
methods.description: Deletes all items, attributes, and survey responses associated with a shopping list.

methods.name: makeListItemSurveyResp
methods.description: Creates survey response records for a shopping list item.

methods.name: getItemAttributeInfos
methods.description: Returns a mapping of item sequence IDs to their attribute key-value pairs.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfos
methods.description: Returns a mapping of item sequence IDs to lists of associated survey response IDs.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfo
methods.description: Returns a list of survey response IDs for a given shopping list item.

methods.name: createGuestShoppingListCookies
methods.description: Creates cookies for guest users to persist shopping list IDs.
